text.p: Northwestern Steel & Wire Co said Robert Gurnitz resigned as chairman, chief executive and a director of the company.
In an announcement dated March 28, the company said Thomas Gildehaus was named to replace Gurnitz.
No reason was given for the resignation of Gurnitz, who was chairman since 1994 and chief executive officer since 1991.
Gildehaus had been president and chief executive officer of UNR Industries Inc. Earlier this month, UNR named a successor to Gildehaus.

Northwestern Steel said Gildehaus will formally join the company on April 14. The board named Richard Way, president and chief operating officer, to serve as interim chief executive officer until then.
Northwestern Steel makes structural steel components.
